row.proto: void **Ui_Format_TextWithTwoNamedIntArgs(void *fmt, void **out_str, int32_t value_a, int32_t value_b)
row.notes: Builds two argument records on the stack (type tag 7, 64-char inline name, int value): name A copied from the C string at fmt+0x8 with value_a, name B from fmt+0x10 with value_b (if both names are equal the second value overwrites the first slot). Then clears *out_str and calls Ne_InternedString_ManageB(args, fmt+0x18, out_str, 0) to substitute into the text held at fmt+0x18; returns out_str. Callers 0x141a9c330 and 0x141a9f660: look up a localised string into fmt+0x18, format it with two ints and write the result to a VM string node via Vm_NodeSet_String; Vm_SponsorGoalsText_Refresh uses the result for the goals[0].current_progress text.
